payload.claim: The Context section cites commit `6266888ab43efbadbb68b8be96fbff00a01b4c79` as the "Reviewer finding on SA-0342," but that commit's actual diff and message ("review(SA-0342): seven of revert's wrong versions survived their own criterion's witness, and the docstring had the skip backwards") touch only saffron/gates/contract.py, saffron/gates/core/revert.py, and tests/test_revert.py, nothing in saffron/record/migrate.py. The commit that actually performed two of the three docstring/comment fixes this spec's Context describes is fc40ec55 (the SA-0342 implementation commit), not the review commit cited. The cited hash does not substantiate the claim it is attached to. This does not change what the cell would build, since the Problem section's instruction to change line 96's "the three" to "the four" is independently correct and verified against the live file.
